event_metrics.bucket_authority: Use exactly the five P5.1 evaluation buckets; do not add a post-result lead/lag search window.
event_metrics.occupancy: For each event x profile x P5.1 bucket report total calendar rows, DATA_INSUFFICIENT rows, classified rows, count/fraction of each P5.3 state, DE_RISK_1_OR_WORSE fraction, DE_RISK_2_OR_WORSE fraction and FLAT fraction. DATA_INSUFFICIENT rows are excluded from classified-state fraction denominators.
event_metrics.first_occurrence: For each event x profile x P5.1 bucket x P5.3 state that occurs, report first occurrence date and signed offset_days = first_date - anchor_date. No date outside the named P5.1 bucket is searched.
event_metrics.transition_count: Count changes between consecutive classified daily states after initialization. DATA_INSUFFICIENT is not a market-state transition.
event_metrics.second_wind_and_control_diagnostics: Use the same occupancy table and frozen event_class labels. Do not introduce custom windows after seeing results.

run_once.rule: After implementation/unit/preflight CI is green, execute the frozen three-profile state-path evidence once. Non-research-definition implementation defects may be corrected with an audited recovery record; state rules/profiles/event metrics may not be retuned after state-path evidence is observed.
